sections.title: Eligibility and preparation
sections.text:
Eligibility for your route [Standing rule]
Completed or completing mathematics bachelor's, or at least 25 semester mathematics credits, calculus
sequence, one semester linear algebra and substantial advanced analysis/algebra. A year each of analysis and
algebra is preferred. International applicants use the same online application; UChicago route fits subject to
actual coursework. [s1] [s6]
Before submission [Standing rule]
Select fall entry in IU Graduate CAS. Arrange official transcripts, three referees, CV, mathematics-course form
and essay(s); request English/GRE waivers explicitly if applicable. Verify the program's current-cycle Home and
Questions tabs before drafting. [s1] [s2] [s8]
Adviser contact [Standing rule]
Initial academic adviser is assigned on arrival; later research-adviser changes need faculty agreement and
graduate-office notification. Prior supervisor commitment is not stated as an application prerequisite. [s2]
Portal workflow [Standing rule]
IU CAS program Home lists deadline, Questions may contain additional essays, Documents marks mandatory
uploads, Recommendations sends invitations immediately when saved. Use correct term/cycle rather than
stale CAS-wide closing dates. [s7] [s8]
Cycle verification [Standing rule]
Standing January 15 and GRE rules; stipend explicitly AY 2026-27. No explicit 2027-entry confirmation of all
requirements found. [s1] [s2]

sections.title: English and GRE
sections.text:
English requirement [Conflict]
Department gives TOEFL minimum approximately 80, old-scale subscores Reading 20, Listening 19, Writing 17.
Funding preference differs: application page says above 90, FAQ prefers at least 100. New 2026 TOEFL scale
and IELTS minimum not established here. Teaching qualification is separate. [s1] [s2] [s5]
UChicago English exemption [Standing rule]
Department permits a requested TOEFL waiver after at least two years attending a US college/university,
including current attendance. John should qualify if his UChicago attendance meets that duration, but request
rather than assume approval. Admission exemption does not remove instructor-language requirements. [s2]
[s5]
GRE General [Standing rule]
Required for PhD under both departmental pages; waiver may be requested by attaching an explanation such
as cost or test access. FAQ warns missing scores could affect admission/funding even when reviewed without
them. Official scores, institution 1324. [s1] [s2]
GRE Mathematics [Standing rule]
Required for PhD; same explanatory waiver route and competitive caveat as General GRE. Official Mathematics
Subject scores, institution 1324. No explicit Fall 2027 revision found. [s1] [s2]

sections.title: Funding and fees
sections.text:
Amount and coverage [Prior cycle]
AY 2026-27 assistantship stipend USD 24,720, not a confirmed Fall 2027 rate. Tuition remission and free
individual Student Academic Appointees health insurance; insurance August 1-July 31, dependents extra.
Academic-year stipend is not a 12-month guarantee; residual fees/summer rate unverified. [s2] [s3]
Years of support [Standing rule]
FAQ commits five years with policy to support a sixth, contingent on progress; financial-support overview
describes six years as typical. Obtain the offer's actual guarantee. [s2] [s3]
International eligibility [Standing rule]
International students can hold assistantships, with instructor eligibility dependent on TEPAIC. Nonnative PhD
students must pass by end of year two for continued support. [s3] [s4] [s5]
Conditions and duties [Conflict]
At least 3.20 IU GPA; normally nine credits per semester including six graduate mathematics credits, with
advanced-stage alternative. Tier 1/2/3 and candidacy milestones plus satisfactory teaching/grading. Workload
pages conflict: funding overview up to 16 hours weekly, FAQ appointments 20. [s4] [s3] [s2]
Extra funding application [Standing rule]
Same application handles admission and fellowship/AI/GA consideration; no separate ordinary-support
application. [s3] [s6]
Other funding routes [Unresolved]
Fellowships have no work obligations; AI involves teaching/assisting, GA grading. Specific external awards,
summer funding and extra-essay requirements must be checked individually. [s3]
Application fee [Standing rule]
USD 70 for international and domestic applicants, nonrefundable, credit card; review starts after payment. [s1]
[s2] [s6]
Fee waiver [Standing rule]
Math says it cannot waive fees. Central routes include selected IU recruitment programs, military/service or
major fellowships; membership/recruitment/service categories include citizenship/PR restrictions. Some
repeat/second-program cases reduce fee to USD 35. Ask grdschl@iu.edu with documented eligibility before
payment; no generic F-1 hardship waiver established. [s2] [s9]
